patch.value: Follow-up to time-bounded guidance. Existing harness formats do not represent the new native validity contract; export deliberately refuses bounded active guidance with a recall/get remedy until a safe portable representation exists.
Preserve guidance validity in portable harness round trips
Define interoperable policy-window metadata and renewal history for portable harness files.
Bounded guidance can round trip without becoming unbounded or silently losing evidence; imported windows are validated before writes.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Claimed portable policy-window work. Design inspection: existing transfer refuses bounded guidance and sequential imports can partially publish. Investigating SDK transactions and existing lease/history surfaces before selecting an atomic import contract. Will preserve window evidence and renewal ancestry, reject broadened or removed bounds, and validate in non-git trackers with crash and competing-writer boundaries.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implemented versioned policy inventory plus editable body files, exact window and renewal validation, full-batch SDK preview/commit, deterministic recovery ids, foreign-record skips, and staged export publication. Targeted suite: 24 passed before the final update/rollback and independent-export tests were added. Randomized sets cover both harnesses, mixed bounded/unbounded guidance, kinds, tags and renewal counts. Existing unbounded byte-preserving transfers remain supported. CI now invokes the explicit npm release:check gate as well as the existing Bun gate; local full release gates are intentionally deferred to CI on this saturated host.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Read-only public-copy validation passed: 17 public items, 6 nonempty bodies, 232693 projected input bytes; 17 derived scenario guidance records, 34 renewal records retained per harness, 19 exported files per harness, all 17 unchanged on identical retries, zero lost windows/evidence, edited bodies needs-renewal. Every source file was permission-protected and its aggregate fingerprint remained unchanged. Evidence: docs/portable-guidance-validation.md. The first unrestricted read created only SDK runtime metadata caches, so the measured run used an independently extracted read-only copy.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Revert proof: in an isolated source snapshot with only transfer.ts restored from origin/main, node --test test/portable.test.ts failed all 16 new regressions (0 pass, 16 fail). Additional focused behavioral reversions preserved the new exporter: restoring only legacy importDir failed 5/5 selected import/refusal/atomic/concurrency regressions; replacing deterministic import ids with random ids failed the SDK crash-recovery regression; removing the writer lease failed the competing-import peer-success regression. Production sources were never reverted in place. Current targeted portable suite: 16/16 pass, with src/portable.ts measured at 100% statements/branches/functions/lines. Typecheck, lint, docstrings and zero-duplication checks pass. The pm-linked npm run typecheck passed through pm test --run --only-last --progress.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: SDK usage: certified listAllComplete, native get/history verification, settings/schema APIs, acquireLockLease/fence, previewItemMutations, commitItemMutations, resolveAuthorIdentity and host TOON/JSON rendering. SDK limitation: PmClient has no bound batch-commit method; the public commitItemMutations helper requires an explicit filesystem pmRoot, so hosted backend acceptance is not claimed. Its atomicity is logical with compensation/recovery; unrelated readers and writers outside the package lease are not isolated. No SDK core behavior was reimplemented.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Ready-for-review PR: https://github.com/unbraind/pm-memory/pull/15 . Final ownership review added filtering before memory decoding: unrecognized-source Knowledge records, including malformed foreign metadata, are skipped with explicit reasons and never adopted or deleted. Focused current tests: 5/5 pass. Removing only the ownership-filtered read makes the new malformed-foreign-record regression fail. The initial CI is running explicit npm release gates on Node 22/26 and Bun on Node 26.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Initial Node 26 CI release gate ran 262 tests with 262 pass and zero skips, then correctly refused 99.9% branch coverage (100% required): transfer.ts had a platform-specific rename-code branch. Replaced the equivalent code comparison with a platform-independent recognized-code set and added a real filesystem permission failure/retry regression. Thresholds remain unchanged. Local pm health reports only managed extension host skew (pinned SDK 2026.10.23 versus the local pm-github build 2026.10.24); history integrity is clean and CI tracker health passed. No dependency pin or shared extension configuration was changed.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Final fixture correction uses the SDK create options object; npm run typecheck and the malformed-foreign-record regression now pass. The real publication-permission regression also passes, and restoring only the original publish function makes it fail (missing expected refusal). Source implementation is ready for orchestrator review in PR 15; the item stays in_progress. Claim is released while the final unchanged-threshold npm/Bun CI gates verify the pushed revision; exact run URLs and counts are maintained in the PR evidence.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Review reopened the class of stateful round-trip defects: content-addressed replay can suppress A/B/A updates, raw provenance is not SDK-normalized, and policy transfers drop native relationships. Reclaimed the existing item. Will bind replay identity to target history, use SDK write/read normalization as the provenance oracle, preserve typed relationships, and replace the narrow property with at least 500 seeded state-machine sequences read back through the SDK after every operation.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Three focused regressions now pass: A/B/A updates read back as A; newline/CRLF imports retry without false native-edit skips; mixed bounded/unbounded graph edges retain kinds and targets, including removals. Revert proofs in isolated snapshots: content-only transaction identity fails older-manifest replay (0 pass/1 fail); raw-body provenance comparison fails whitespace retries (0/1); removing exported relationships fails the mixed graph round trip (0/1). The normalized baseline is captured from SDK reads after writes and committed in a second recoverable batch. Target history anchors plus the frozen pending plan cover both stages; expanded create/update crash tests pass (14 SDK transitions for two records). The 500-sequence model is running.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: The review model has passed more than 380 independent sequences so far without a failure. It compares complete semantic content, bounds, and relationship targets/kinds against a reference model after every step, using raw SDK-read normalized snapshots only as the provenance oracle. Expanded boundary testing passes: both SDK data and provenance transactions recover from every create/update transition; foreign or corrupt pending records are skipped or refused without adoption. Targeted coverage measured portable-plan.ts at 100% in all four dimensions. Portable relationship metadata is now required in the Memory SDK projection, preventing callers from accidentally representing a native graph only as an untyped id list.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Model property PASS: 500 independent seeded sequences, 7500 complete SDK-read state comparisons, master seed 0x1363cafe (325307134), per-sequence seed = (master + imul(index, 0x9e3779b9)) >>> 0. Operations: export, import archived/older manifests with A/B/A, native body/description/relationship edits, leading/trailing whitespace and CRLF variants, link additions/removals, mixed bounded/unbounded guidance, final native rebase and import(X)==X. Zero failures, skips or cancellations. Each failure prints master seed, sequence seed, operation and step. Three targeted review regressions pass; targeted crash/compensation tests pass; four pending-plan/relationship validation tests pass. Source typecheck, lint, docstrings and zero duplication pass. SDK gaps retained: PmClient has no bound batch helper; previewItemMutations does not expose normalized staged values, so provenance uses actual SDK write/read capture; no public journal-status reader is exposed, so the owned SDK snapshot journal is inspected read-only for completion. Native SDK edge import reasserts author_source; kinds, targets, author/time/source data and original input remain retained.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: CI c6a1567: npm and Bun on Node 26 each passed 272 tests, 2 packed acceptance tests, 500 sequences/7500 state checks and 100% coverage across 28 sources. Node 22 passed its other 271 tests but hit the 30-minute model-test timeout after 100 sequences (no assertion failure). Clock-only profiling showed no meaningful improvement. Optimized the harness instead: one certified SDK read now supplies both independent model checks and normalized provenance, and each case clones a verified initial A state INCLUDING completed journals instead of redundantly recreating it. Every case still performs A/B/A, six random operations, final rebase, and 15 SDK-read checks; all 500 sequences and 7500 checks are retained. Per-sequence subtests bound test-runner resources and expose seeds individually; the full-case time allowance is 90 minutes. Production fixes and coverage thresholds are unchanged. Local Node 22 coverage profile passes all 10 sampled sequences/150 checks. The unchanged full 500-sequence optimized run is active locally.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Harness optimization retains the full reference model, operation alphabet, seed formula and 7500 sequence-step SDK assertions. It seeds and verifies A/B/A once via SDK, copies the completed A journals into each independent tracker, then tests the exact A retry, B update and older A replay in every sequence. Each step performs one complete SDK read shared by content/graph assertions and the read-back provenance oracle; native snapshots are accepted as baselines only after content/graph equality passes. Each sequence has its own subtest and fail-fast completion assertion. The default count remains 500, with six random operations plus the fixed replay/rebase steps. No SDK mocks, skip paths or reduced coverage thresholds were added. Typecheck, lint and zero duplication pass after the optimization.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Final candidate CI confirms npm and Bun on Node 26: 772 tests plus 2 packed acceptance tests per gate, all 500 sequences/7500 checks, 28 sources at 100% in every dimension. Node 22 hit the 90-minute parent timeout after 239 completed sequence subtests (510 total passing tests, zero assertion failures). Its per-sequence time grows from about 3 seconds to 40-59 seconds. Will bound process lifetime to ten independent sequences per real Node worker while retaining the identical 500 global seeds, operations, SDK assertions and coverage collection. No production changes or coverage exclusions are planned.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: The new worker model still detects each behavioral revert in isolated snapshots: content-only identity fails master/sequence seed 325307134 at sequence 0 step 6 (older A replay); raw-body provenance fails the SDK-verified seed B application; omitted relationships fail the seed graph import. Every mutant exits nonzero. Parent orchestration also refuses a worker that exits zero without a complete SDK-read receipt. The existing testEnvironment helper clears inherited Node test-runner context while retaining NODE_V8_COVERAGE for real child-process source coverage.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Worker lifetime validation PASS under real Node 22 c8: two consecutive ten-sequence workers completed all 20 sequences/300 SDK-read checks, parent 3/3 tests, zero failures/cancellations/skips. Worker durations 52.5 and 43.7 seconds; production source coverage was collected from the children. The first single-process 90-minute run remains a failed gate, not accepted evidence. Full CI now runs 50 workers with exactly the same 500 global seeds and 7500 checks; no source behavior or thresholds changed. Current typecheck, lint and docstrings pass. Temporary profile sources are removed before duplication and commit.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Round-two review retains the round-trip fixes but identifies moved-state defects: recovery overwrites edits made after intent, skipped foreign targets leave dependent edges, and saved-input equality can misreport current content. Reclaimed the existing item. Will use SDK revision compare-and-set on every mutation, close plans under skipped dependencies, compare unchanged against current SDK state, and extend the same 500 seeded model with recovery/native-edit/ownership/body-restoration transitions plus behavioral revert proofs.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implemented target revision/history expectations, SDK item-lock CAS via BulkItemUpdateMutation.match on updated_at, unique-key guards for creations, and revision guards before replay and at SDK boundaries. A moved plan interrupts SDK forward replay without compensating over the newer edit, then returns a typed conflict; conflicting intents stay preserved for explicit reconciliation. Snapshot batches are now frozen too. Skip roots close transitively over dependent rows before mutation selection. Unchanged compares current SDK content with incoming values through canonicalDocument and itemDocumentToMutationOptions, not saved input. The original 18 portable regressions and all six review regressions pass, including native edits at every journal boundary and fresh CAS boundaries. Expanded model retains 500 seeds, now 33 checks per sequence (16500 total); sampled eight sequences passed before the local timer, with no assertion failure. Five-sequence workers bound instrumentation state; full gates remain CI-only.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Closed the related partially-created graph case by staging all new nodes without edges via an SDK transaction, then reading their real revisions before the CAS data/relationship batch. Node/data/provenance stages retain frozen recovery payloads; a native edit between stages refuses before overwrite, and a foreign target appearing after the first node cannot leave a dangling edge. Tests now inject every one of the 21 SDK boundaries for two-record creations and all 15 for a one-record competing import, plus package stage boundaries. Explicit moved-state conflicts preserve the intent; the remedy names only the owned intent for preservation/removal after review and asks for a reviewed current export. No foreign records or SDK journals are deleted.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Behavioral revert proofs PASS in isolated source snapshots, with production never reverted in place. Removing revision/history guards and SDK CAS matches fails the focused newer-edit recovery regression and model sequence 0 step 32 (retry preserves newer native edit). Removing skip closure fails the focused foreign graph/retry regression and model sequence 0 step 28 (skip closure stays retryable). Restoring saved-input unchanged detection fails the focused native-A restore/retry-B regression and model sequence 0 step 19 (retry restore B). All model counterexamples print MASTER_SEED=325307134 and SEQUENCE_SEED=325307134. Each focused mutant has 0 pass/1 fail; each model mutant has 0 pass/2 fail including the fail-fast parent. Current five-sequence worker passes 6/6 tests and all 165 SDK-read checks, zero failures/cancellations/skips.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Model extended further to include 100 fresh-tracker branches within the same 500 sequences: all node/data/provenance journal boundaries, plus foreign ownership after a creation crash. The model now enforces 16933 SDK-read state checks, including no dangling references and stable repeated recovery. Samples at sequence starts 0 and 50 pass 12/12 tests, 10 sequences and 339 state checks. The SDK delete-compensation path reserves deleted IDs (item_identity_reserved); node recovery allocates fresh IDs and remaps edges through SDK converters while retaining the old history. All 12 node/data/provenance compensation boundaries converge; mixed existing/new graph tests and native-peer-before-rollback tests pass. Intent writes and removals are lease-fenced and compare the last owned token, preserving a foreign replacement instead of overwriting/deleting it.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Ready for full CI: targeted portable/plan/review suite 38/38 passed, no failures/cancellations/skips. c8 measured portable.ts, portable-plan.ts and portable-replan.ts at 100% statements/branches/functions/lines. Typecheck, lint, docstrings and zero duplication pass. Intent replacement/removal now compares an operation-bound token under the live lease, retains late foreign/corrupt/amended files, and recognizes a peer-drained completed intent as success. SDK-owned partial progress matching the current input can capture its baseline without falsely claiming a native edit. The three reviewed behavioral reverts fail both focused and seeded model regressions, recorded above. Full 500-sequence/16933-check model and complete npm/Bun release gates are deferred to CI on the pushed head; final run URL and counts will be maintained in PR 15. SDK gap found and handled: delete compensation reserves IDs in history (item_identity_reserved), so node recovery rebinds identities and relationships rather than reusing a reserved identity.
